items.question: Can you guarantee a number one ranking?
items.answer: No, and any agency that promises this isn't being straight with you — nobody controls Google's algorithm. What we can guarantee is a properly executed strategy and honest reporting on what it's achieving.

items.question: Do I own my website once it's built?
items.answer: Yes, completely. The site, the content, and the domain are yours — there's no dependency on us to keep it running.

items.question: How quickly will I see results?
items.answer: Results vary by service. SEO is a longer-term investment that builds over weeks and months rather than overnight, while a new website or ad campaign can start generating enquiries much sooner after going live.

items.question: How will I know what I'm getting for my money?
items.answer: You'll get monthly reporting written in plain English, not a dashboard full of numbers with no explanation. If something isn't working, we'll tell you.

items.question: Is my customer data safe with the AI tools you use?
items.answer: Yes — the tools we use are limited to your own business data, such as your services and review requests, and don't share it beyond what's needed to do the job.

items.question: Are there any hidden fees on top of what you quote me?
items.answer: No. The only additional cost is ad spend if you're running Google Ads, and that goes straight to Google, not to us.

items.question: Am I locked into a long contract?
items.answer: No — our work runs on a monthly rolling basis with no long-term tie-in. We'd rather earn your business every month than lock you into a contract.

items.question: Who do I speak to if I have a question?
items.answer: The person doing the work — not a call centre or a rotating account manager. Direct access is part of how we operate.
